title: Capstone: Library Management System
description:
```
=== City Library ===
1) Add book  2) Register member  3) Borrow  4) Return  5) Search  6) Overdue report  0) Quit
```
hints: Start with `Book` alone and two or three books made in `main`. Then `Library` with `addBook` and `findByIsbn`, then members, then borrowing. Run after each.
`findByIsbn` can return a `Book*` (or `nullptr` when there is no such book): the caller then changes the book in the library itself, not a copy.
Case-insensitive search: lower-case copies of both strings with `std::tolower` in a loop, then `text.find(query) != std::string::npos`.
requirements: Classes `Book` (ISBN, title, author, available) and `Member` (id, name, the ISBNs they have borrowed, at most 3), and a `Library` that owns a `std::vector` of each
Borrow and return enforce the rules: a book that is out cannot be borrowed, a member cannot pass 3 books
Search by title or author, ignoring case and matching part of a word
Each class in its own `.h` and `.cpp` (add files with the New file button above the explorer), and a short `main.cpp` menu
stretch: Due dates and overdue fines with the `Date` class idea from lesson 6.07, and saving the library to a text file.
